scope: Analytical berth-to-berth voyage planning. This application is not an ECDIS or a navigational authority.

active_policy.base_path: A* maritime-network route with sea-side endpoint connectors
hard_constraints: Never derive route legs from display or risk-polygon boundaries.
Retain exact endpoint connectors and measure the displayed polyline.
Only use reviewed, named water-only corridor fixtures as route replacements.
soft_constraints: JWC and piracy-watch features are exposure overlays until a reviewed water-only avoidance corridor is available.
ECA exposure is measured and reported; it is not converted into a rectangular detour.
Canal and passage restrictions are passed to the maritime network.
validation: Polyline distance is recomputed from returned coordinates.
Route profile and policy are returned with each result.
Regression test blocks the retired coarse JWC boundary detour.

provider_patterns.pattern: Shortest feasible sea route accounts for traffic-separation schemes and port entries; supports vessel dimensions/draft, speed limits, HRA/ECA preferences, blocked areas, and crossed-area reporting.
Routing templates and passages are selected at company or vessel level; weather layers are displayed separately from route options.
Builds berth-to-berth passage plans with chart updates, weather and risk overlays, automated route generation, validation, and shore-to-bridge consistency.
Optimizes against safety, ETA, fuel, emissions and commercial goals using vessel-specific constraints, frequent weather updates, and expert review.
Defines traffic separation schemes, recommended tracks, deep-water routes, precautionary areas and areas to be avoided; weather routing supports safety but is not a substitute for navigation.

implementation_plan.work: Water-network-first routing. Removed coarse JWC boundary routing, retain the reviewed Beira-Port Sudan corridor, recompute displayed distance, and disclose policy.
License or integrate authoritative ENC/bathymetry and IMO routeing layers; validate every segment against that navigational dataset and return a validation report.
Add vessel IMO, draft, air draft, speed profile, departure time, canal rules and reviewable route templates.
Add forecast-driven alternatives, weather and current penalties, fuel/emissions objectives, rerouting cadence and master/shore approval workflow.
